title: This Tower Hides a 660-Ton Steel Ball
lines: This tower in Taiwan is five hundred and eight meters tall.
And up here, strong winds and typhoons push it all the time.
Without help, the top would sway enough to make people feel sick.
So the engineers hid a secret inside.
A giant steel ball, six hundred and sixty tons, hanging from huge cables.
When the wind pushes the tower one way, the ball swings the other way.
That can cut the sway by up to forty percent.
It's called a tuned mass damper. Follow for more!
caption:
Taipei 101 hides a 660-ton steel ball between floors 87 and 92 🏙️ It swings against the wind and cuts the sway by up to 40%, so people inside don't feel sick.
